name: Vibe Replay
description: Turn AI coding sessions into shareable, interactive replays. Auto-generates GitHub PR artifacts (markdown + animated GIF), self-contained HTML replays, and session analytics. Supports Claude Code and Cursor.
longDescription:
Ships **1 skill**, `replay` (Find, analyze, and share AI coding sessions with vibe-replay).

Installs with `claude plugin install vibe-replay@claude-community` from `tuo-lei/vibe-replay`.

Turn Claude, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode, Hermes, and Pi sessions into shareable, interactive replays.
